cohort.offender_definition: Living convicted serial-killer records with life/death-sentence, named-inmate, or explicit incarceration evidence in the source dataset; obvious released/collective-name false positives excluded from the analyzed pair set.
cohort.control_definition: Nobel laureates used only as a high-accomplishment public-life proxy, not a measure of subjective happiness.
cohort.control_matching: Greedy same-sex where offender sex known, nearest unused birth year within 12 years; primary person-to-person sensitivity subset restricted to year gap <=5.

birth_time_policy: No houses, Ascendant, MC, or exact-time Moon claims. Date-only astrology used noon UT planetary longitudes for Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn and compact element/modality counts.
numerology_policy: DOB-only Pythagorean-style reductions with 11/22/33 preserved. Name numerology excluded because canonical birth/legal names and aliases are inconsistently documented.

repeated_random_same_year_control_classi.interpretation: No stable out-of-sample separation from same-year random birth dates.

nobel_high_achievement_proxy_gap_le_5y.interpretation: Only date-only astrology showed a small exploratory bump; it was not conventionally significant and becomes less persuasive after considering multiple feature families.

conclusion: No validated numerology/astrology algorithm separates this offender cohort from controls. Life Path 7 and 33 are preregistration candidates only; the current data do not support using birth patterns to infer individual violence or dangerousness.
next_test_if_continued: Freeze Life Path 7/33 and the exact date-only astrology feature set, then test them once on a new independently sourced offender cohort and exact-year matched non-offender people without retuning.
